requirement:
修复管理后台 API 的数据模型不一致问题。
管理端的订单、用户、路线等接口返回的数据字段与前端不匹配。
需要统一管理后台各服务的数据模型。

details.name: ts-admin-route-service
details.rationale: Admin route service likely depends on basic info service for route data models.

details.name: ts-admin-travel-service
details.rationale: Admin travel service likely shares data models with basic info service for travel-related fields.

details.name: ts-admin-user-service
details.rationale: Admin user service likely interacts with basic info service for user data consistency.

details.name: ts-admin-order-service
details.rationale: Admin order service likely shares data models with basic info service and may need alignment for order-related fields.

details.name: ts-route-service
details.rationale: Route service provides route data that admin route service may consume, so model changes could propagate.

details.name: ts-travel-service
details.rationale: Travel service provides travel data that admin travel service may consume, so model changes could propagate.

details.name: ts-order-service
details.rationale: Order service provides order data that admin order service may consume, so model changes could propagate.

details.name: ts-user-service
details.rationale: User service provides user data that admin user service may consume, so model changes could propagate.

details.name: ts-gateway-service
details.rationale: Gateway service routes requests to admin services and may need updates if API contracts change.

details.name: ts-travel2-service
details.rationale: Travel2 service may also provide travel-related data that admin services depend on.

details.name: ts-auth-service
details.rationale: Auth service may be involved in admin API authentication and could be affected by model changes.
